properties.name: jwt.secret.access-token
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and validate JWT access tokens. Keep this value secure and unique.

properties.name: jwt.secret.refresh-token
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and validate JWT refresh tokens. Should differ from the access token secret for enhanced security.

properties.name: jwt.secret.otp_secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and validate JWT refresh tokens for otp validation. Should differ from the access token secret for enhanced security.
